content:
Hi,
I am a student researcher and I wanted to prove in LEAN the results of the paper that I am about to publish but for that I needed some Random Set Theory that wasn't in Mathlib yet so I Vibe Prooved a good part of the foudations of RST. I was wondering how could I add those to Mathlib.
Thank you for your help.

Hugo Dunias

Usually just open a PR basically. For more info see https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute
If it is generally novel, you might want to open a Zulip thread first discussing what might be the best way implementing this. This is especially true, when you define novel things etc.

But as Snir has implied already, there is a big chance if you just blindly used AI on it, that it wont be accepted into mathlib anytime soon.
